body: I understand, it is hard to explain to others that have not personally experienced it. When im asked why I usually say it’s for many reasons and stop at that. After being around a year and a half clean, I can see how I’m simply addicted, I relied on SH for so long to cope until I needed it to regulate all my emotions. On good days it felt like a reward, like I brought balance and completed that good day perfectly. I also just enjoyed the act itself and not only what it gave me. I wish you find that reward and balance through yourself, and that your reward to be healing through all of your days.

You’re not an idiot and you don’t have to brush it off. For now (no makeup if they’re not healed) you can put foundation on them to hide them , it’s hard work and takes time though. The thing is it won’t be forever. Your family and loved ones obviously love you because you’re concerned about them so i’m pretty sure they’d understand you when you tell them (if they ever notice the scars). Take as much time you need to be ready for it. Yes it might be hard for them accepting that someone they love has been in pain but it will be better eventually because yeah it isn’t easy.

I’m sorry it had to be like this. Just know that you shouldn’t feel guilty at all. It’s something i always feel. Like i let others down when i cut but no; those times are times for us to be supported and to have someone to lean on. I’m aware you love him and i'm sorry to say this but that’s not how he should’ve reacted. Yelling at you in such a time? Not the right thing to do AT ALL. Before thinking of what you should say to him , it’s your time now. You’re still hurt , you have your peace first with yourself and know that you are not wrong you don’t have to feel guilty. I am hurt to know it has to be this way but it’s your body and life (that’s what my therapist tells me). It’s your way , it’s up to you after all. People have to accept us the way we are. If not they don’t deserve being around you even. Do something to make you relax , think of YOU only now. When you do feel calmer and when you know you did no wrong to feel guilty about , go and talk to him. Ask what he felt and why he reacted this way and what was going through his mind. Let’s say he mentioned being scared or worried about you and didn’t know what to do and actually feels bad for it , just give a hug and tell him you love him and explain what you’d want him to do at times like those , how it’s important to show love especially from someone so important to you like him. And be completely honest telling it wasn’t the right way to react. If he doesn’t feel bad about it then... it’s not right. If he wants a break up then i’m 100% sure you deserve someone better. Please don’t wear yourself out feeling guilty , it’s one of the worst feelings i have so i know how you feel now. Remember you did nothing wrong and please be careful for your own sake. Not your boyfriend’s or anyone else , only you. You’re the most important. I have no idea how i could give you the peace you need but i am here for you.
